WITH (

PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
WITH (
  SELECT 
    cf.investorId,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cf.type IN ('SIP', 'Lump Sum', 'Deposit') THEN -cf.amount ELSE cf.amount END) AS net_cash_flow
  FROM wm:CashFlow cf
  GROUP BY cf.investorId
) AS cash_flows,

(
  SELECT 
    ra.investorId,
    SUM(ra.amount) AS total_rebalance_amount
  FROM wm:RebalancingAction ra
  GROUP BY ra.investorId
) AS rebalances,

(
  SELECT 
    sr.investorId,
    SUM(ABS(xsd:decimal(sr.newAllocationPct) - xsd:decimal(sr.currentAllocationPct))) AS total_scenario_shift
  FROM wm:ScenarioRebalancing sr
  GROUP BY sr.investorId
) AS scenarios

SELECT 
  ?investorId
WHERE {
  {
    SELECT 
      ?investorId,
      ((xsd:decimal(?net_cash_flow) - ?min_cf) / (?max_cf - ?min_cf)) AS ?norm_cf,
      ((xsd:decimal(?total_rebalance_amount) - ?min_rb) / (?max_rb - ?min_rb)) AS ?norm_rb,
      ((xsd:decimal(?total_scenario_shift) - ?min_sc) / (?max_sc - ?min_sc)) AS ?norm_sc
    WHERE {
      INCLUDE cash_flows BIND (xsd:decimal(net_cash_flow) AS ?net_cf_val)
      INCLUDE rebalances BIND (xsd:decimal(total_rebalance_amount) AS ?rb_val)
      INCLUDE scenarios BIND (xsd:decimal(total_scenario_shift) AS ?sc_val)

      FILTER EXISTS { INCLUDE cash_flows }
      FILTER EXISTS { INCLUDE rebalances }
      FILTER EXISTS { INCLUDE scenarios }

      BIND ((?net_cf_val - ?min_cf) / (?max_cf - ?min_cf) AS ?norm_cf)
      BIND ((?rb_val - ?min_rb) / (?max_rb - ?min_rb) AS ?norm_rb)
      BIND ((?sc_val - ?min_sc) / (?max_sc - ?min_sc) AS ?norm_sc)
    }
    GROUP BY ?investorId
  }

  BIND ((?norm_cf + ?norm_rb + ?norm_sc) / 3 * 100 AS ?transaction_rebalance_index)
}
ORDER BY DESC(?transaction_rebalance_index) ?investorId
LIMIT 10
